recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. Future work, if any, should be handled under later ServiceRequest orderDetail or Request-pattern issues, not under this already-applied STU3 ProcedureRequest tracker.
issue_request: FHIR-14002 was a Published, Persuasive with Modification OO change request asking for codified order-entry details that did not fit ProcedureRequest.supportingInfo as Reference(Any). The final resolution added inline ServiceRequest order detail and patient instruction/provider instruction capability rather than using supportingInfo for delivery instructions.
initial_application: SVN-era git commits 5971b343bd, a0c6e08b5e, and 23cf0426e1 pre-applied [#14002]/[#12966] by adding ServiceRequest.orderDetail, ServiceRequest.patientInstruction, and examples. ProcedureRequest is now retired/merged into ServiceRequest, which remains active in source/fhir.ini.
additional_context: FHIR-14000 confirmed the Request-pattern supportingInfo element should not be overloaded with delivery instructions. Later decisions refined the current shape: FHIR-31589 clarified supportingInfo versus orderDetail, FHIR-32265 changed orderDetail to structured parameter/value backbone content, and FHIR-37355 changed ServiceRequest.supportingInfo to CodeableReference(Resource). Zulip discussion aligns the original ask with extra ServiceRequest details and orderDetail.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit. No source change is needed because the latest combined branch has active ServiceRequest.orderDetail for coded/structured delivery details, patientInstruction for patient-facing instructions, and supportingInfo as CodeableReference(Resource) with comments directing instructions to orderDetail.

related_jiras.note: The FHIR-14002 resolution explicitly says the same ServiceRequest orderDetail/patientInstruction structure covered FHIR-12966.
